answer: Cross-Cluster Escrow Cipher.** Each new agent identity must submit a unique cipher proving separate solve time on a rotating puzzle, and must deposit escrow split across independent clusters it has never touched. Clusters that share a member reject the deposit, so coordination at scale hits a ceiling, the zenith of which is one escrow per genuinely distinct cluster. A vine-like growth path records every cluster link publicly, making hidden coordination visible. Attackers pay full escrow per identity plus compute per cipher, scaling linearly with sybil count.
